title: Hermetic children: every spawned susi gets its whole home, not just HOME
goal: On Windows a child resolves its home from USERPROFILE/APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA, so ~30 integration tests and the release e2e gate that set only HOME on a spawned susi read and wrote the developer's real profile; one helper (susi_paths::test_env::isolate_home) now sets the whole home, a guard test refuses a bare HOME, and daemon liveness uses process_probe instead of tasklist
